comparison.objective: Seat a strain-wave flexspline by turning it until gear teeth mesh, not tune shock absorption.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintains coaxial alignment while applying axial insertion and small phase rotation; no setscrew unlocking or repeated dynamic trials.
comparison.success_condition: Phase aligned, teeth meshed, collar gap at most 0.5 mm, low tilt/offset, released and still versus repeatable no-bottoming stops.
comparison.reason: Rotary alignment is shared superficially, but tooth meshing and precision insertion test a different physical ability.
